title: Law Against Discrimination source-of-income and income-standard protection in housing
requirement: A landlord, broker, or agent may not refuse to rent or otherwise deny housing because of a lawful income source, refuse to accept any lawful income as rent payment, or apply a minimum income requirement or financial standard not based exclusively on the portion of rent the tenant pays.
coverage_conditions: Applies to any person with the right to sell, rent, lease, assign or sublease real property, and to real estate brokers or salespersons; covers refusal to accept lawful income sources and minimum income standards not based on the tenant's rent portion.
quoted_span: including, but not limited to, by refusing to accept as payment any source of lawful income, or by applying, in assessing eligibility for the rental of housing, any minimum income requirement or financial standard that is not based exclusively on the portion of the rent to be paid by the tenant;
